runtime_observation_rules.semantic_problem: Synthetic normalized internal code/status projection only. Registered review HTTPwire is NOT qualified and currently omits404; do not amend contract here.
runtime_observation_rules.child_lock: Actual lock-only second writer shares namespace then probes the fixed exact selected row. Observe pg_blocking_pids and actual backend identity/start plus successful same-row acquisition only after positive first-terminal. No table-lock or query-string-only proof. No permission mutation bypasses namespace.
runtime_observation_rules.row_channel: Actual PostgreSQL VALUES result exercises driver/decoder rows32/33 without adding stored fixture rows or pretending it is an indexed stored-closure overflow. Production LIMIT/lookahead and global bound remain separately source/native qualified. No authority/effect may be admitted by channel-only tests.
runtime_observation_rules.faults: Control mutates only exact owned synthetic DB/role/constraint, retains actual old/new catalogue and data, and restores before next case. No broad RLS/constraint disable or fabricated seed-as-verdict.
runtime_observation_rules.disclosure: Every finite result excludes foreign IDs/counts, raw SQL/binds, paths/credentials and backend causes; denied cases emit no marker or product receipt.
runtime_observation_rules.final_effect: A held fence is not a reusable observation. The final isolated effect rereads locked current rows and samples the originating trusted clock again immediately before effect authorization. Exclusive grant/source expiry still denies with positive rollback and no marker/CAS. A read-only project.read decision cannot advance resource control. These supplied-clock boundary inputs perform no external work or sleep while locks are held.
runtime_observation_rules.boundary_refinement: Additional native boundary inputs require complete real before/after state, catalogue/constraint and terminal observations. Helper guard_cases have explicit representation or harmless owned filesystem scope only, with no SQL/server-profile/whole acceptance inferred. No fixture identity, expected object or reason enters a producer.
